triaging_steps.action: Reply on the alert thread (do not formally Ack) so the team knows triage has started
Break down ext_authz_error events by cluster, namespace, and deployment

tool_params.query: index=meg_dataplane respCodeDetails=ext_authz_error | stats count by kubernetes_cluster, kubernetes_namespace, kubernetes_deployment_name | sort - count

triaging_steps.action: Classify each affected cluster as TKE (names starting with 'px' or 'tt') or Conduktor (DUCK) so the correct dashboard is selected

tool_params.prompt: For each kubernetes_cluster from step_2_output, classify the platform: clusters whose names start with 'px' or 'tt' are TKE; all others are Conduktor (DUCK). Return a mapping of cluster -> platform.

triaging_steps.action: Inspect TAG resource dashboard for the affected cluster/namespace/deployment, then DECIDE: if Memory % > 65 OR CPU % > 65 OR pod_restarts > 0, call TAG PE Tier-2 (execute remediation step 12) before continuing; otherwise continue to step 5

tool_params.dashboard: Application Monitoring Dashboard or Resource Usage Splunk O11y Dashboard
tool_params.on_threshold_breach: trigger remediation step_id 12 (page TAG PE Tier-2)

triaging_steps.action: Post the TAG dashboard screenshot and link to the internal Teams thread

Check TaapSec (taap-validator-ms) for connection or 5xx errors. If the result is empty, post 'no 5xx errors / connection errors on taap validator ms' to the internal Teams thread; otherwise post the Splunk link and a screenshot of the result table to the internal Teams thread (handled in step 8)

tool_params.query: index=meg_dataplane serviceName=taap-validator-ms "java.net.ConnectException" OR httpStatusCode="5*" | stats count by kubernetes_cluster, kubernetes_namespace, kubernetes_deployment_name, kubernetes_pod_id, kubernetes_pod_name | sort -count

on_empty_result.message: no 5xx errors / connection errors on taap validator ms

tool_params.on_non_empty_result: include splunk_link and result_screenshot when posting in step 8

triaging_steps.action: Inspect TaapSec resource dashboard for the affected cluster/namespace/deployment, then DECIDE: if Memory % > 65 OR CPU % > 65 OR pod_restarts > 0, call TAAPSEC Tier-2 (execute remediation step 13) before continuing; otherwise continue to step 8. Also note any network errors / dropped packets

tool_params.dashboard: Application Monitoring Dashboard or Resource Usage Splunk O11y Dashboard

triaging_steps.action: Post the TaapSec dashboard screenshot and link to the internal Teams thread
Validate whether failures are caused by long-running client requests (~7 seconds, clientDuration > 6500 ms)

tool_params.query: index=meg_dataplane respCodeDetails=ext_authz_error kubernetes_cluster={cluster} kubernetes_namespace={namespace} proxyName=* clientDuration>6500

triaging_steps.action: Visualize TaapSec node-level latency to detect node-localized slowdowns - high latency isolated to specific nodes that recovers quickly typically indicates VMotion (node migration), not a system-wide issue

tool_params.query: index=meg_dataplane eventType=performAuthChecks kubernetes_namespace={namespace} kubernetes_cluster IN ({clusters}) kubernetes_deployment_name=taap-validator-ms-prd* processingTimeMillis>1000 | timechart span=1s avg(processingTimeMillis) by kubernetes_node_name

triaging_steps.action: Synthesize all gathered data and decide root cause / disposition

tool_params.prompt: Analyze ext_authz_error data and decide one of: (a) single spike < 5 minutes with no follow-on errors -> close, no action; (b) sustained or repeated -> escalate per remediation rules; (c) high latency localized to specific nodes that recovers quickly -> likely VMotion (node migration), no action. Possible upstream causes to consider: TAG to TaapSec call did not reach TaapSec; TaapSec took too long to respond; TaapSec response did not reach TAG in time; high memory utilization of the TAG node.

remediation_steps.action: Page TAG PE Tier-2 team - TAG resource thresholds breached or TAG pods restarting
Page TAAPSEC Tier-2 team - TaapSec resource thresholds breached or TaapSec pods restarting
Tag DPO core team and Tier-2 owners in the alert thread when two consecutive alerts have been received for the same signature

communication_steps.action: Teams communication to the teams channel API CFE - Internal | tag-internal

escalation.action: create incident in service now if any step in the triaging or remediation steps fails
